      <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox@3.3.0/dist/css/glightbox.min.css">

  - text: |
      <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox@3.3.0/dist/js/glightbox.min.js"></script>
      <script>GLightbox({ selector: '.photo-grid a', loop: true, touchNavigation: true });</script>

  freeze: false   # rebuild every render so new photos always show up
---

<!--
  This page builds itself from photos/sections.yml and photos/gallery/.
  To add photos, see the instructions at the top of photos/build_photos.R.
-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false

sections <- yaml::yaml.load(readLines("photos/sections.yml", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE))

# width/height from the JPEG header, so the grid doesn't jump while photos load
jpeg_dims <- function(path) {
  con <- file(path, "rb"); on.exit(close(con))
  b <- readBin(con, "raw", n = 65536)
  i <- 3
  while (i < length(b) - 8) {
    if (b[i] != as.raw(0xFF)) { i <- i + 1; next }
    m <- as.integer(b[i + 1])
    if (m %in% c(0xC0:0xC3, 0xC5:0xC7, 0xC9:0xCB, 0xCD:0xCF))
      return(c(as.integer(b[i + 7]) * 256 + as.integer(b[i + 8]),
               as.integer(b[i + 5]) * 256 + as.integer(b[i + 6])))
    i <- i + 2 + as.integer(b[i + 2]) * 256 + as.integer(b[i + 3])
  }
  c(NA, NA)
}
esc <- function(x) gsub('"', "&quot;", gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE)

# map web file name -> caption (captions are keyed by original file name)
web_key <- function(f) {
  s <- tolower(tools::file_path_sans_ext(f)); gsub("^-|-$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s))
}

shown <- Filter(function(s) length(list.files(file.path("photos/gallery", s$folder, "thumb"))) > 0, sections)

cat('<nav class="theme-filters">\n')
for (s in shown) cat(sprintf('  <a href="#%s">%s</a>\n', s$folder, esc(s$title)))
cat('</nav>\n\n')

for (s in shown) {
  thumbs <- sort(list.files(file.path("photos/gallery", s$folder, "thumb"), pattern = "\\.jpe?g$"))
  caps <- s$captions
  if (length(caps)) names(caps) <- vapply(names(caps), web_key, "")

  cat(sprintf('\n\n## %s {#%s .gallery-heading}\n\n', s$title, s$folder))
  if (!is.null(s$subtitle)) cat(sprintf('<p class="gallery-sub">%s</p>\n\n', esc(s$subtitle)))
  cat('<div class="photo-grid">\n')
  for (f in thumbs) {
    th <- file.path("photos/gallery", s$folder, "thumb", f)
    fu <- file.path("photos/gallery", s$folder, "full", f)
    d  <- jpeg_dims(th)
    cap <- caps[[sub("^[^_]*_", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(f))]]
    alt <- if (is.null(cap)) paste("Photo from", s$title) else cap
    cat(sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" class="lightbox" data-gallery="%s"%s><img src="%s" alt="%s" loading="lazy" decoding="async"%s></a>\n',
      fu, s$folder,
      if (is.null(cap)) "" else sprintf(' data-description="%s"', esc(cap)),
      th, esc(alt),
      if (is.na(d[1])) "" else sprintf(' width="%d" height="%d"', d[1], d[2])))
  }
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{=html}
<style>
h2.gallery-heading { margin-top: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: .2rem; border-bottom: none; scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.gallery-sub { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: .9rem; opacity: .7; }
.photo-grid { column-count: 4; column-gap: 12px; }
.photo-grid a { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; break-inside: avoid; }
.photo-grid img {
  display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 4px; background: #E8ECF2;
  transition: opacity .2s;
}
.photo-grid a:hover img { opacity: .85; }
@media (max-width: 1100px) { .photo-grid { column-count: 3; } }
@media (max-width: 700px)  { .photo-grid { column-count: 2; column-gap: 8px; } .photo-grid a { margin-bottom: 8px; } }
</style>
```
